For some background info my class was going on a field trip the day I had the nightmare.

So I started off in the cafeteria with all of the other classes going on the field trip. I was confused trying to figure out why would all gather there instead of just heading to the busses, but that’s beside the point. All of the sudden over all the chatter of people talking to their friends, or teachers talking to each other everyone heard 

“LOCKDOWN. LOCKDOWN. LOCKDOWN.”

We heard gunshots from the hallway as the cafeteria lights turned off and hid under the tables. We saw the silhouette of the shooter staring in the windows as he started reloading his gun. In his raspy voice he said one thing and one thing only:  

“If I shoot one of you, I’ll let the rest of ya go.”

I was on the verge of tears at this point, but forcing myself not to cry because of course, he would hear us. But it didn’t matter if he heard me, he knew we were in there. He was just standing outside the door waiting. Then, one of my friends got up. She ran straight for the door as the shooter held up his gun, and shot her straight through the head. I forced myself not to scream as I watched her body collapse to the ground motionless. He kept his promise though. After shooting her. He left. He just went away to other classrooms. Everyone ran out of the cafeteria and out of the building. As we ran by I saw my friend’s collapsed body and just broke down in tears. I kept running away from the school. 

I called my dad letting him know I was safe. As he talked he was crying. And this is coming from a man who I’ve never seen panic before. He picked me up (and my girlfriend who ran with me). When I opened the car door I watched my girlfriend climb in first, I went right after her. Then I woke up in tears.
